about: The pinned CodeQL CLI and the query suite the local scan runs (spec 148). scripts/codeql-local.sh installs the bundle outside the repository and refuses a download whose sha256 differs from the one recorded here.

cli.chosen_because: github/codeql-action v4.38.2, the latest release on 24 Sep 2026, sets bundleVersion codeql-bundle-v2.27.1 in src/defaults.json
cli.sha256_source: the digest GitHub shows for the release asset, and sha256sum of the downloaded file, read on 2 Oct 2026
cli.launcher_sha256_source: sha256sum of the launcher script the archive unpacks, read on 2 Oct 2026; it covers the launcher and not the tools beside it

suite_source.name: default
suite_source.words: The default query suite is the group of queries run by default in CodeQL code scanning on GitHub.
